look_up_zip_code.description: Find the city and state a US ZIP code belongs to, for filling in the rest of an address or checking what someone typed into a form. Territories and military addresses are covered too. A ZIP code Ziptastic does not know comes back with 'found' set to false rather than failing the step. No API key required.
look_up_zip_code.name: look_up_zip_code

parameters.description: A five-digit US ZIP code. ZIP+4 such as 48867-1234 is fine: only the first five digits are looked up.
parameters.name: zip_code

city.description: The city or town, in normal capitalisation, e.g. 'Owosso'.

city_as_listed.description: The city exactly as Ziptastic lists it, in capitals, e.g. 'OWOSSO'.

country.description: The country's two-letter code: always 'US' for a ZIP code found.

found.description: True when Ziptastic knows this ZIP code. False means it has no record of it, and the place fields are empty.

state.description: The state's two-letter USPS abbreviation, e.g. 'MI'.

state_name.description: The state, territory or military region written out, e.g. 'Michigan', 'Puerto Rico' or 'Armed Forces Europe'.

summary.description: One line naming the place, e.g. 'Owosso, MI 48867', or saying that no place was found.

zip_code.description: The five-digit ZIP code that was looked up, e.g. '48867'.

description: Turn a US ZIP code into the city and state it belongs to, to fill in the rest of an address or check what someone typed into a form. Covers every state, Washington DC, the territories and military addresses. No account or API key required.
